svg.title: One write path
svg.desc: A statement's changes become one commit record, which is appended to the write-ahead log and then applied to the in-memory graph that every query reads. A checkpoint later writes the committed graph to a snapshot in the store's codec and recycles the log segments the snapshot covers. Opening a store loads the latest snapshot and replays the log records written after it.
